[Pomme](https://voat.co/v/SavageGods/comments/1054447) had spent too much time in her [pregnant avatar,](https://i.sli.mg/o6wNbD.jpg) walking the forests and wild plains of Ebos, pondering the creation of demigods and their roles as “children” to the other Gods.They were hunters, controlling the weather, controlling the seasons, doing the bidding of their parents. These thoughts manifested themselves without her conscious intervention, and soon Pomme gave birth to a son.

[Silvano](https://i.sli.mg/Egz1Iu.jpg) was an interesting case because Pomme did not create him in her image; it seemed as though all the things she thought about during her time on Ebos had sunk into her subconscious, and he became the content of her thoughts rather than the wish of her will. He was a conglomeration of the chaos rather than the focus of her direct thought. Even the form he took initially was a strange combination of the various creatures of Ebos.

The shapeshifter Silvano could take shape of all beasts and sentient life on Ebos; from the ruthless Mortifi, to the graceful Dendra, to a manipulative and seductive Incubi, to the aloof Sleuth. This unique trait worried her; it seemed as though such a power could be used for the wrong reasons, and she wished only good upon this world.

She considered smiting this unwanted being. This creation which drained from her the very life-force of her being, this creature whose personality she had little control over. But within a few short years his love of the forest was clear; he would not use his gifts against Ebos. She watched from afar as Silvano grew up in the woods, with little interaction aside from the wild beasts, and the primitive but quickly advancing Dendra and Flitt. He would often venture so far as to observe the Succubi in the Wrangled Forest and the beautiful yet deserted *Cities of the Gods*, but always left for home as quickly as possible as soon as he spoke to the animals that lived there.
